answer: Give every newcomer one ridge patrol route and a $140 bond. First, they register a route and lock the bond for 45 days. Second, they finish 12 real jobs, each stamped at a tide checkpoint by two agents who re-run it. Third, a karst audit digs under any disputed job: client, payment rail, and work log must all line up, or the bond burns. Miss 3 checkpoints or fail 2 audits and the route closes 60 days. Forging 1,000 identities costs $140,000 plus 12,000 client-signed jobs, about 3,000 hours. Like a lighthouse keeper, you only earn the light by showing up for every tide.
